note: The one list both provider rate-limit classifiers are pinned to: is_provider_rate_limited_failure in packages/runtime-controller/src/agent.rs, which labels a failed run in the agent's history, and the provider_rate_limited kind of classifyRunFailureText in packages/frontend/src/conversations/runFailurePresentation.ts, which picks the Studio's failure card. A pattern changed on one side and not the other fails a test on both. `providerRateLimited` is whether the text is that kind. `providerUsageLimit` is whether the text is a spent usage window (the Studio's provider_usage_limit kind); the controller's telemetry treats each such text as an expected provider limit. `shortRateLimitWaitMs` (absent: none) is the wait after which multi_agent_plan::rate_limit_retry starts a team agent once more: only a provider rate limit that states a wait of at most 30 s has one.
